handoff: Approve: review#1's blocking finding is fixed (a red verify receipt now applies at whichever gate/merge park the story waits at, proven by the approve-before-red-receipt test); AC1–AC7 traced, tests and typecheck green; two minor notes remain (verify worktree leak on a killed check-run, misplaced doc comment).

findings.title: A killed check-run leaks its temporary merged worktree
findings.detail:
sweepCheckOrders unlinks a dead order without reading order.verify, so the norn-verify- worktree stays in `git worktree list`. Carried from review#1, not fixed.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Read the stale order and remove order.verify's worktree before unlinking it.

findings.title: classify's doc comment sits above verified()
findings.detail:
The 'Tick-classified outcomes' JSDoc now precedes verified()'s own JSDoc, leaving classify undocumented. Carried from review#1, not fixed.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Move verified() above that comment.
